title: NetFlow — Detecção de Anomalias e Ataques

panels.title: Banda WAN — Total / LAN→WAN / Inbound→Público (bytes por minuto)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(time_received) AS time, sum(bytes)/60 AS "Total Bps" FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(time_received) AS time, sum(bytes)/60 AS "LAN→WAN Bps" FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) AND match(src_addr,'^192\.168\.') AND NOT match(dst_addr,'^(192\.168\.|10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\.)') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT toStartOfMinute(time_received) AS time, sum(bytes)/60 AS "Inbound→Pub Bps" FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) AND dst_addr='${pub_ip}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
WITH per_min AS (SELECT toStartOfMinute(time_received) AS m, sum(bytes)/1024/1024 AS mib FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) GROUP BY m) SELECT max(mib) AS peak FROM per_min
SELECT uniq(src_addr) AS lan_hosts FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) AND match(src_addr,'^192\.168\.')

panels.title: Sources externos batendo no IP público

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniq(src_addr) AS ext_sources FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) AND dst_addr='${pub_ip}' AND NOT match(src_addr,'^(192\.168\.|10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\.)')
SELECT sum(bytes) AS total FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received)

panels.title: Top hosts LAN — UPLOAD para WAN

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_addr AS host, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes)) AS up, sum(packets) AS pkts, uniq(dst_addr) AS uniq_dst, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(5)(dst_addr), ', ') AS sample_dsts FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) AND match(src_addr,'^192\.168\.') AND NOT match(dst_addr,'^(192\.168\.|10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\.)') GROUP BY host ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top sources externos batendo no IP público

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_addr, proto, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes)) AS B, sum(packets) AS pkts, uniq(dst_port) AS uniq_dport FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) AND dst_addr='${pub_ip}' GROUP BY src_addr, proto ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT toStartOfMinute(time_received) AS minute, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes)) AS B, sum(packets) AS pkts, uniq(src_addr,dst_addr) AS pairs FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) GROUP BY minute HAVING sum(bytes) > ${spike_threshold_mb}*1024*1024 ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT src_addr AS host, dst_port AS port, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes)) AS up, sum(packets) AS pkts, uniq(dst_addr) AS uniq_dst FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) AND match(src_addr,'^192\.168\.') AND NOT match(dst_addr,'^(192\.168\.|10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\.)') AND dst_port IN (8080,9090) AND proto='TCP' GROUP BY host, port ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT proto, dst_port AS port, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes)) AS up, sum(packets) AS pkts, uniq(src_addr) AS uniq_src FROM netflow.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(time_received) AND match(src_addr,'^192\.168\.') AND NOT match(dst_addr,'^(192\.168\.|10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\.)') GROUP BY proto, port ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 20

WITH hourly AS (SELECT src_addr, toStartOfHour(time_received) AS h, sum(bytes) AS up FROM netflow.flows WHERE time_received > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND match(src_addr,'^192\.168\.') AND NOT match(dst_addr,'^(192\.168\.|10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\.)') GROUP BY src_addr, h), stats AS (SELECT src_addr, avg(up) AS mean, stddevPop(up) AS sd FROM hourly WHERE h < toStartOfHour(now()) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY src_addr), last_h AS (SELECT src_addr, sum(bytes) AS up_last FROM netflow.flows WHERE time_received > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND match(src_addr,'^192\.168\.') AND NOT match(dst_addr,'^(192\.168\.|10\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\.)') GROUP BY src_addr) SELECT s.src_addr AS host, formatReadableSize(l.up_last) AS up_last_h, formatReadableSize(toUInt64(s.mean)) AS hist_mean_h, round((l.up_last - s.mean) / nullIf(s.sd,0), 2) AS zscore FROM stats s INNER JOIN last_h l USING (src_addr) WHERE l.up_last > 100*1024*1024 AND s.sd > 0 ORDER BY zscore DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20
